verdict.rationale: GrowthBook exposes a full REST API and read-only SDK Connection Endpoint for programmatic, headless management of flags/experiments, and its SDKs evaluate flags locally without any UI dependency, which supports automation and CI-driven workflows (e.g., promoting flags across dev/staging/prod environments). Self-hosting via Docker Compose also lends itself to scripted/CI deployment. However, there is no explicit CI/CD guide, GitHub Actions integration, or dedicated CLI for running GrowthBook headlessly in pipelines. Missing for 10: documented CI/CD integration examples (e.g., GitHub Actions, headless flag-sync scripts), an official CLI tool, and independent evidence of real-world CI usage.
